column2: It looks as though everyone is safe.
I'd like to say we made it out, but...
Well now, $$ダーリン$$! Our pretty new outfits...
As it happens, these armors of ours match the $$大邪神$$ armor you $$ダーリン$$s wear...
They're ancient armors with a dark history!!
C-could that armor of yours be the one that fought the $$大邪神$$s in the war of the gods...?
Our Lord $$サタン$$'s $$守護天使$$... the $$大天使の鎧$$!!
Since the armor's abilities are equal, and that loudmouthed $$ガイ$$ isn't here,
the balance of $$戦力$$ is already four against three or better...
My $$ダーリン$$, why don't you give up and surrender quietly already?
Mmm... You don't need to worry about a thing!!
For now, $$ダーリン$$, you'll live in my sweet little home...
and every day, until I am too tired and sleepy, I plan to have you work very, very hard!
Aaaahh!
Getting to make a man who says he loves another woman my $$奴隷$$...
Getting to make a man who says he loves another man my $$奴隷$$...
Just thinking about it gives me chills!
Wha—
(What is with this woman?!)
Grrr! Now I'm mad!!
Huffing and puffing—kaboom!!
Now then, $$ダーリン$$! This time, I'll deal with you personally.
Until you give birth to a baby with black $$羽$$... I won't let you sleep easily!
